title: Discovered by Mercenaries!
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: When the Mandalorian is forced to take a job with an old mercenary crew, he does his best to keep Grogu hidden aboard the ship. But when the Droid 09-0 intercepts a message about the child and his value, the Mandalorian is forced to complete the mission on his own, rescue Grogu, and ensure the capture of all his erstwhile allies.
